About this item

  • Gum Health and Plaque Removal: The A3 Premium All-in-One brush head featuring longer, angled bristles with triangular tips delivers up to 2000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 600% healthier gums²; ideal for those managing gum sensitivity or following a dentist's care plan
  • Next-Generation Sonicare Technology: Delivers 62,000 bristle movements per minute with zero drop in performance, even in hard-to-reach areas; Sonicare Fluid Action drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline for a clean that feels smooth, thorough, and complete
  • Visual Pressure Sensor: A light ring at the base alerts you when you're pressing too hard; simply ease off when it lights up to keep gums protected throughout every session
  • Personalized Brushing Modes: Choose from 4 brushing modes, Clean for everyday brilliance, Sensitive for gentle care, Gum Health for targeted gum support, and White for a brighter finish, across 3 intensity levels to match your needs
  • Smart Coaching with App: The Sonicare toothbrush and app pair seamlessly to deliver guided brushing, tips and tricks, and personalized content that helps you build a consistent routine and reach your long-term oral health goals
  • BrushPacer and SmartTimer: Every 20 seconds, the BrushPacer prompts you to move to a new area; after 2 minutes, the SmartTimer signals your session is complete for confidence in every clean
  • Brush Head Replacement Reminder: Tracks how often and how hard you brush, then reminds you when it's time for a fresh head; dental professionals recommend changing your brush head regularly to maintain optimal performance
  • Extended Battery and Travel Case: Rechargeable toothbrush provides up to 21 days of brushing on a full charge; the included charging travel case lets you maintain your routine on business trips and vacations
  • The set includes: 1x Philips Sonicare 7300 Series electric toothbrush, 3x A3 Premium All-in-One brush heads, 1x charging travel case, 1x charging stand (power adapter not included)

Product Description

The Philips Sonicare 7300 Series Sonic Toothbrush is designed for adults who want effective cleaning with a gentle touch, whether you're upgrading your routine after a dental recommendation or replacing a worn brush. Paired with the A3 Premium All-in-One electric toothbrush head, it delivers up to 2000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 600% healthier gums² for a thorough, dentist-clean feeling every time. Behind that performance sits Next-Generation Sonicare Technology: the motor produces 62,000 bristle movements per minute and adjusts power automatically, so there is zero drop in performance even in hard-to-reach areas. Sonicare Fluid Action drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline, reaching where bristles alone cannot for a powerful yet gentle clean. A visual pressure sensor lights up at the base when you're pressing too hard, so gums stay protected session after session. With 12 brushing settings across four modes, Clean, Sensitive, Gum Health and White mode, and three intensity levels, you can dial in the clean that feels right. The Sonicare toothbrush and app pair seamlessly to deliver guided brushing, tips and tricks, and personalized content that helps you build a consistent routine. The BrushPacer prompts you every 20 seconds to move to a new area; after 2 minutes, the SmartTimer signals you're done. A brush head replacement reminder tracks how often and how hard you brush, then alerts you when it's time for a new one. Enjoy up to 21 days of regular brushing on a single charge with the included charging travel case keeping your routine on track wherever you go. ¹ vs. a manual toothbrush ² in Clean mode vs. a manual toothbrush in 2 weeks

  • How does the pressure sensor feedback work on my Sonicare toothbrush?

    Your Sonicare toothbrush measures the pressure you apply while brushing to protect your gums and teeth. If you apply too much pressure, the handle will change its vibration.

  • How do I know when to replace the brush head?

    Your Sonicare toothbrush will track the wear of your smart brush head, using the BrushSync technology. It measures the overall pressure you apply while brushing, and the total time you have brushed with your brush head.

  • Can I use my Philips Sonicare Toothbrush in the shower?

    It is completely safe to use your Philips Sonicare Toothbrush in the shower. Allow the toothbrush to air-dry between uses. Also, do not place the charger where it might risk contact with water.

  • How does the BrushPacer work on my Philips Sonicare Toothbrush?

    The BrushPacer divides brushing time into six equal segments and indicates when you should move to the next area. Segments are indicated with a brief pause in vibration. The toothbrush automatically stops at the end of the brushing session.

  • How to clean my Philips Sonicare toothbrush?

    Cleaning your toothbrush and brush heads regularly improves their lifespan and performance. Clean your toothbrush after use by rinsing your brush head and bristles. Wipe the handle with a damp cloth.

Customers say

Customers find this electric toothbrush to be the best they've used, with effective cleaning that leaves their mouths feeling fresh and clean. The battery life is positive, with fast charging and USB charging while lying flat inside the box, and they appreciate the multiple brushing settings and included travel case. 5 out of 5 stars
Like a velvet jackhammer to remove plaque
Philips Sonicare has so many variants of its Sonicare toothbrushes that it is almost impossible to figure out which ones you need. At the highest end of the Philips lineup, the ultrasonic transducer puts out more power than the economy-priced ones. The one you want for plaque removal is the one with the highest output power. Period. If you are willing to read spec sheets (I am), the 7300 is one of the lowest cost versions of the products with their highest power output and with their best plaque cleaning brush heads. The same motor goes into the more expensive 9000 series, but outside of cool blinking lights and nifty charging doodads that make you feel good about spending more $, there is not much functional difference between this 7300 and their most expensive products. It appears that some of the 6000 and higher-numbered 4000 series also have the higher frequency, but they don't have many variations in power settings, so I think that the 7000 series is a good blend of capability and features. However, the 7300 in particular comes with 3 of their plaque remover heads, which are also insanely expensive - arguably because they contain a higher density of filaments. Why do you care about filament density? Because you want to translate the ultrasonic output of the motor as directly as possible to the bristles that are cleaning your teeth. More power + more bristle filament density = better plaque removal. To paraphrase "Bones" the crusty doctor on Star Trek - "Darn it Jim, I am not a dentist, I am an engineer" You should probably check with your dentist before buying a toothbrush. But physics transcends marketing, and more power at the same frequency translates into more scrubbing power (which seems like the point of brushing your teeth). I have had this product for about a month now, and my teeth feel absolutely clean and free of plaque. Like stepping out of the Dentist's chair after a cleaning, only every day! I hope my jibber jabber is helpful.

    I’ve been using the Sonicare 7300 for a few weeks now and it’s made a noticeable difference in how clean my teeth feel. The pressure sensor is genuinely useful — it lights up if I’m brushing too hard, which I didn’t realize I was doing with my old brush. The SmarTimer keeps me honest about brushing the full two minutes, and it pulses every 30 seconds to remind you to switch quadrants.

    Having 12 different brushing settings might sound like overkill, but I actually use a few of them — the gum care mode is gentler on my gums, and the whitening setting feels more thorough for the odd coffee stain.

    Battery life is excellent — I’m easily getting close to the advertised 21 days on a single charge, so I’m not scrambling to find the charger during travel. The included travel case is a nice touch and keeps everything protected in my bag.

    Only minor gripe: it’s a bit pricier than a standard electric toothbrush, and replacement brush heads add up over time. But for the overall brushing experience and results, it’s worth it.

    Bottom line: A solid, feature-packed electric toothbrush that’s easy to recommend if you want something better than a basic model without going full premium.

    4 out of 5 stars
    A new level in toothbrush performance, but no wall plug and an intrusive app
    Reviewed in the United States on May 22, 2026
    Color: Pearl WhiteSize: 1 Count (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This toothbrush appears to live up to the extravagant claim on the box. I have no way of knowing if the amount of plaque removed is actually 2000% more than what my previous Sonicare could do, but it is a huge improvement. I used to believe the job of an electric toothbrush was to pound my gums into submission, but this model is far more gentle and does a better job of reaching the tricky trouble spots my dentist never tires of pointing out. So I do recommend this product with almost no reservations.

    But before you open the box you should know that the power cord is a USB-A plug, wall unit not included. Phillips says this is to cut down on electronic waste, which is such an obvious euphemism for "it saves us money" that you wonder why they even bothered.

    Also, the Sonicare 7300 has Bluetooth connectivity, and you can download an app and connect to, um, your toothbrush. I said what the heck I'll give it a try. The app says it values your privacy but then it doesn't let you complete setup unless you agree to send all data to Phillips so they can help you with suggestions for improving your dental hygiene. Then the home screen comes up and it's a dental chart, at which point I killed the app and uninstalled it. Perhaps you might find such detailed help useful, but I'm not interested in being an unpaid beta tester or belonging to a floating focus group for future products.

    I've been using a Sonicare for years and will continue to do so. But the way this product is packaged and presented seems to make it just another way that big business is trying to carve off a big slice of my conscious awareness. And I’m getting tired of that.

    The Philips Sonicare 7300 doesn’t just clean your teeth — it judges your entire dental existence. In the best way.

    The first time I turned it on, I swear it sounded like it was saying, “Move aside, amateur, I’ve got this.” And it did. This thing blasts plaque off your teeth like it’s clearing a runway. My mouth hasn’t felt this clean since the day I grew my first tooth.

    The pressure sensor lights up like a tattletale every time you brush too hard. The timer keeps you honest. The brush heads feel like they were engineered by NASA for enamel. And the clean afterward? Unreal. My teeth are so smooth I’m convinced I could butter toast with them.

    It’s powerful, it’s smart, it’s slightly condescending — and it’s absolutely fantastic.

    Five stars. My dentist is going to weep with joy.

About this Item

  • Gum Health and Plaque Removal: The A3 Premium All-in-One brush head featuring longer, angled bristles with triangular tips delivers up to 2000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 600% healthier gums²; ideal for those managing gum sensitivity or following a dentist's care plan
  • Next-Generation Sonicare Technology: Delivers 62,000 bristle movements per minute with zero drop in performance, even in hard-to-reach areas; Sonicare Fluid Action drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline for a clean that feels smooth, thorough, and complete
  • Visual Pressure Sensor: A light ring at the base alerts you when you're pressing too hard; simply ease off when it lights up to keep gums protected throughout every session
  • Personalized Brushing Modes: Choose from 4 brushing modes, Clean for everyday brilliance, Sensitive for gentle care, Gum Health for targeted gum support, and White for a brighter finish, across 3 intensity levels to match your needs
  • Smart Coaching with App: The Sonicare toothbrush and app pair seamlessly to deliver guided brushing, tips and tricks, and personalized content that helps you build a consistent routine and reach your long-term oral health goals
  • BrushPacer and SmartTimer: Every 20 seconds, the BrushPacer prompts you to move to a new area; after 2 minutes, the SmartTimer signals your session is complete for confidence in every clean
  • Brush Head Replacement Reminder: Tracks how often and how hard you brush, then reminds you when it's time for a fresh head; dental professionals recommend changing your brush head regularly to maintain optimal performance
  • Extended Battery and Travel Case: Rechargeable toothbrush provides up to 21 days of brushing on a full charge; the included charging travel case lets you maintain your routine on business trips and vacations
  • The set includes: 1x Philips Sonicare 7300 Series electric toothbrush, 3x A3 Premium All-in-One brush heads, 1x charging travel case, 1x charging stand (power adapter not included)

Product Description

The Philips Sonicare 7300 Series Sonic Toothbrush is designed for adults who want effective cleaning with a gentle touch, whether you're upgrading your routine after a dental recommendation or replacing a worn brush. Paired with the A3 Premium All-in-One electric toothbrush head, it delivers up to 2000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 600% healthier gums² for a thorough, dentist-clean feeling every time. Behind that performance sits Next-Generation Sonicare Technology: the motor produces 62,000 bristle movements per minute and adjusts power automatically, so there is zero drop in performance even in hard-to-reach areas. Sonicare Fluid Action drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline, reaching where bristles alone cannot for a powerful yet gentle clean. A visual pressure sensor lights up at the base when you're pressing too hard, so gums stay protected session after session. With 12 brushing settings across four modes, Clean, Sensitive, Gum Health and White mode, and three intensity levels, you can dial in the clean that feels right. The Sonicare toothbrush and app pair seamlessly to deliver guided brushing, tips and tricks, and personalized content that helps you build a consistent routine. The BrushPacer prompts you every 20 seconds to move to a new area; after 2 minutes, the SmartTimer signals you're done. A brush head replacement reminder tracks how often and how hard you brush, then alerts you when it's time for a new one. Enjoy up to 21 days of regular brushing on a single charge with the included charging travel case keeping your routine on track wherever you go. ¹ vs. a manual toothbrush ² in Clean mode vs. a manual toothbrush in 2 weeks
